verdict.rationale: AngelList is an equity and fund-management SaaS with some AI features, such as the Tie Out Assistant, so being an MCP client is conceivable and the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows users can connect MCP servers or extend its AI with external tools. Its documented integrations are HRIS/payroll connectors, and the llms.txt probe concerns documentation for LLMs, not MCP client support.
